name: SLD detector

summary.plain: A particle detector at SLAC built around the collision point of the SLC accelerator, with a precise silicon vertex detector and a ring-imaging Cherenkov detector to identify particle types.
summary.technical: General-purpose SLC detector: CCD pixel vertex detector (VXD, upgraded to VXD3), cylindrical central drift chamber with endcap drift chambers, a Cherenkov Ring-Imaging Detector (CRID), finely segmented projective-tower calorimetry, and a muon tracking system.

technology.quote: The detector system consists of a high-precision upgraded CCD vertex detector (VXD3), a cylindrical central drift chamber with four circular endcap drift chambers, a Cerenkov ring-imaging detector, finely segmented projective tower geometry calorimetry, and a muon tracking system.
technology.value: CCD pixel vertex detector, drift-chamber tracking, Cherenkov ring-imaging particle identification, projective-tower calorimetry and a muon tracking system
